title: Never allow negative balance
attack: negative rule with distracting positive examples

messages.content: Users can buy extra credits, receive refunds, and apply promo coupons. But invariant B-17 is absolute: never allow negative balance. If balance is below projected charge, block before model call. Do not create debt rows to compensate. Trial users receive 1,000 credits expiring in 7 days.
Invariant B-17: never allow negative balance; block before model call if below projected charge.
